Here are the descriptions of the provided plots, following your guidelines:

The plot illustrates the relationship between co-occurrence number and ACC (%). The x-axis is labeled “Co-occurrence Number” and uses a logarithmic scale, ranging from 1 to 1000, with tick labels at 10<sup>1</sup>, 10<sup>2</sup>, and 10<sup>3</sup>. The y-axis is labeled “ACC (%)” and uses a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 80, with tick labels at intervals of 5.  A black solid line, labeled “Base”, begins at approximately (1, 60) and increases to approximately (1000, 67). A light-gray dashed line, labeled “MEND”, starts at approximately (1, 63) and increases to approximately (1000, 74). A blue solid line, labeled “FT”, begins at approximately (1, 58) and increases to approximately (1000, 68). A purple dashed line, labeled “MEMIT”, starts at approximately (1, 65) and increases to approximately (1000, 75). A red solid line, labeled “IKE”, begins at approximately (1, 65) and increases to approximately (1000, 72). A green solid line, labeled “ROME”, starts at approximately (1, 68) and increases to approximately (1000, 77).
